当前对话首次使用 ADP 时，建议查阅这份业务指南。后续任务可直接复用已读内容。: Consult this guide when first using ADP in a conversation. Reuse it for subsequent tasks. Examples from invoices, orders, IDs, and contracts explain when to parse full text, use one-off field extraction, classify pages, or reuse or create an app. The guide also covers supported file formats, synchronous and asynchronous processing, concurrency and rate limits, checking and topping up credits, and sending feedback to ADP.
《ADP 文档处理业务指南》正文。: The ADP document processing guide in Markdown.
将本机文件上传到 ADP，返回可用于解析、抽取或分类的下载地址。多份文件应在一次: Upload local files to ADP and return download URLs for parsing, extraction, or classification. For multiple files, include the entire batch in files in one call. The tool uploads them in parallel without waiting for separate calls one file at a time. Each result includes the original file_path, file_name, and input index to identify the source file. Continue processing successful items with data.download_url. If some files fail, keep the successful items and identify each failed source file. If error.acceptance_unknown=true, verify the upload status before retrying, and do not resubmit the whole batch. Skip upload when downloadable HTTP(S) URLs are already available.
当前上传工具可读取的本地文件绝对路径或 file:/// 地址。: An absolute local file path or file:/// URL that this upload tool can read.
一项对应一个要上传的文件。: One entry represents one file to upload.
填写本次要上传的全部本机文件，每个文件一项。工具并行上传，按 index、原始: Provide all local files to upload in this batch, one file per item. The tool uploads them in parallel and returns each result with its index, original file_path, and file_name. Reuse successful data.download_url values and identify failed source files. Verify unknown outcomes before retrying, and do not upload successful files again.
每个文件填一项本机路径。: Provide one local file path per item.
将一份文档的全文或指定原始页解析为正文、表格和版面结构，供阅读、翻译或构建知识库: Parse an entire document or selected original pages into text, tables, and layout structure for reading, translation, or building a knowledge base. Enhanced Parsing 2.0 (fast_vlm) is the default. You can switch modes, remove headers, footers, and page numbers, or recognize and extract stamps. If header and footer removal is enabled and no mode is specified, Intelligent Parsing 2.0 (agentic_v2) is used. If the user asks for OCR but only needs values such as amounts or ID numbers, use extract_document. By default, parsing runs synchronously and returns the result. For background processing, pass wait=false, then use the returned task_ref with get_task.
填写一份文档可下载的 HTTP(S) 地址，也可使用上传返回的 download: Supply a downloadable HTTP(S) URL for one document, including a download_url obtained after uploading.
可选文件名。无法从地址判断文件名时，建议提供含扩展名的名称。: Optional filename. Include the extension when the URL does not identify the file type.
用户指定模式时使用对应值。agentic（智能解析）适合内容类型多样、版式复杂的: Honor the mode the user requests. Choose agentic (Intelligent Parsing) for mixed content and complex layouts, fast_vlm (Enhanced Parsing 2.0) for consistent parsing of scans, complex layouts and multiple tables, agentic_v2 (Intelligent Parsing 2.0) for complex tables or formulas, and thai_ocr for predominantly Thai documents. Omit to use fast_vlm. If header and footer removal is enabled without an explicit mode, agentic_v2 is used.
需要核对原文时传 1，保留文本块和表格在原页面上的位置，可能略微增加耗时。传 0: Set to 1 to retain the positions of text blocks and tables on the original page for verification. This can add processing time. Set to 0 to turn it off. Supported in agentic, fast_vlm and agentic_v2. Omit to use the parsing service’s configured setting.
填写原文档中的页码，从 1 开始。: Use the page number in the original document, starting at 1.
要解析的原始页码，从 1 开始。省略或传 [] 时处理全部页面。: Original page numbers to parse, starting at 1. Omit or pass [] for all pages.
传 true 去除识别出的页眉、页脚和页码。支持 agentic 和 agent: Set true to remove detected headers, footers and page numbers. Supported in agentic and agentic_v2. Setting true without recognize_mode selects agentic_v2.
去除页眉、页脚和页码: Remove headers, footers and page numbers
需要单独提取印章时传 true。在支持的文档类型且已开通印章识别能力时，返回识别: Set true to extract stamps separately. For supported documents and accounts with stamp recognition enabled, results include stamp text and positions, and an image URL when a crop is available.
true（默认）调用同步接口并直接返回结果；false 创建异步任务，返回可供: true (default) calls the synchronous endpoint and returns its result. Set false to create an asynchronous task and receive a task_ref for get_task.
wait=true 的同步请求时限，默认 60 秒。超时返回错误，处理结果可能未: the synchronous request timeout in seconds when wait=true. Defaults to 60. A timeout returns an error and the processing outcome may be unknown. Ignored when wait=false.
每次解析一份文档，用 file_url 提供下载地址。: Parse one document per call and supply its download URL in file_url.
同步调用返回本次文档处理的结果；异步受理后可用顶层 task_ref 调用 ge: A synchronous call returns the document processing result. After asynchronous submission, pass the top-level task_ref to get_task. If a synchronous call times out or submission is uncertain, keep the error and avoid automatic resubmission.
从一份文档提取字段值，例如身份证上的姓名、合同中的付款期限。根据用户是否指定抽取:
Extract field values from one document, such as a name from an ID card or a payment deadline from a contract. Choose how to extract based on the app, fields, or document type the user specifies.

**Named extraction app.** Pass a known `app_id` with the file. To find a team app, call `list_apps` with `engine_type=extract`, `source=custom`, and `app_name`. If the user gives only an app name, search by name and engine type across both sources. Ask the user to choose if multiple matches remain. When the user names both an app and specific fields, use the app's rules and report only the requested fields.

**One-off extraction.** When the user names the fields for this request and has not chosen an app, pass the file and `fields` (1–20) directly. This returns the values synchronously and needs no catalog lookup. For example, extract just the payment deadline and late fee from this contract.

**Document type only.** For a request such as “extract this ID card”, call `list_apps` with `engine_type=extract`, `source=preset`, and `document_type`, then extract using the returned `app_id`. If no preset matches, choose fields from the visible document and its intended use, or ask which information matters if that is unclear.

Report the fields the extraction returned and identify any requested fields that were missing. Call `parse_document` for full-page text, Markdown, or layout when the user also asks for that output.

**Professional extraction (custom extraction app).** Recommend evaluating a custom extraction app when field accuracy, processing speed, consistency across layouts, or long-term reuse matters. Once the user chooses to create one, use `create_app` to save field types, extraction rules, and output formats. Use the returned `app_id` on representative samples to measure accuracy and processing time.

Extraction by `app_id` is synchronous by default. For background processing, pass `app_id` and `wait=false`, then query `get_task` with the returned `task_ref`. One-off `fields` supports synchronous extraction only. If the user asks for both one-off fields and a background task, offer synchronous field extraction or, with their agreement, background extraction using an app.
使用已有预置或自定义抽取应用时填写其 ID。应用规则决定要抽取的字段。按本次指定: Provide the ID of a preset or custom extraction app to use its saved rules. For one-off extraction, omit app_id and provide fields.
提供一份文档的 HTTP(S) 下载地址。仅标准版自定义抽取应用可改传 jobi: HTTP(S) download URL for one document. Only standard custom extraction apps also accept jobid://<32-hex-digit parse task ID> to reuse complete, readable per-page results from a successful asynchronous parse in the same region, tenant and API account (excluding Markdown and Excel). Reuse keeps the original page selection. Supply file_url as the only file source.
按 app_id 抽取时可填写原文件名并保留扩展名。下载地址未显示文件类型时建议: Optional original filename with its extension for app-based extraction. Include it when the URL does not identify the file type, especially for Excel and Markdown. Omit for one-off field extraction.
只为本次抽取指定字段时填写，和 app_id 二选一。按期望顺序填写 1 至 2: For one-off extraction, use fields instead of app_id. Provide 1–20 fields in the desired order, each with a name and optional prompt. Names must be unique after trimming and case folding. Returns field values directly. This mode does not accept page selection, ticket splitting, invoice verification, translation, source positions, confidence or intermediate parse results.
需要提取的字段名，例如合同金额。: Name of the field to extract, such as contract amount.
本次字段的可选要求，例如优先使用含税总金额。: Optional field instructions, such as using the total including tax.
填写一个要返回的字段名称，按需补充该字段的取值要求。: Specify one field to return and optionally describe how to extract its value.
按 app_id 抽取时，从 1 开始指定不重复的原始页码，省略或传 [] 处理: For app-based extraction, select unique original page numbers starting at 1. Omit or pass [] for all eligible pages. Native Markdown has only page 1, card and certificate apps process at most five pages per call, and domestic general bills process the whole file. For a reused jobid, omit pages or specify exactly the original parse selection. Omit for one-off field extraction.
按 app_id 抽取时，经典自定义抽取、采购订单和海外发票及收据标准版可附带逐: Include per-page parse results when using classic custom extraction, purchase orders, or standard overseas invoices and receipts. Off by default. High-speed custom extraction, international high-speed and Southeast Asia invoices, domestic general bills, ID cards and certificates, and delivery notes return the extracted data without intermediate parsing. Use parse_document for full text or Markdown.
附带解析结果（经典自定义、采购订单、海外票据标准版）: Include parse results (classic custom, purchase orders, standard overseas invoices and receipts)
仅海外发票和收据的高速版（国际通用）和东南亚版支持。默认开启，将同一文件中的多张: Available only for the international high-speed and Southeast Asia versions of overseas invoices and receipts. Enabled by default. Splits multiple tickets in one file into separate results. Pass false to disable splitting for this call.
拆分多张票据（海外发票和收据高速版、东南亚版）: Split multiple tickets (international high-speed or Southeast Asia invoices and receipts)
仅中国区的国内通用票据应用接受此参数，可使用预置应用或同类型的账号应用 ID。传: Only China domestic general bills apps accept this option. Use the preset or an account app ID of the same type. Pass true to verify eligible invoices during extraction, false to disable verification for this call, or omit to use the app setting. Omit it for other app types, which reject even false.
随单验真（中国区国内通用票据）: Verify invoices during extraction (China domestic general bills apps)
适用于经典及高速自定义抽取、海外发票和收据、采购订单及送货单。传 true 将可: For classic and high-speed custom extraction, overseas invoices and receipts, purchase orders, and delivery notes. Pass true to translate eligible field values into the language specified by the connection’s Accept-Language header. Numeric values such as amounts can remain unchanged. Overrides this call only. Omit to use the app setting.
翻译字段值（自定义抽取、海外票据、采购订单、送货单）: Translate field values (custom extraction, overseas invoices and receipts, purchase orders, delivery notes)
支持高速自定义抽取、海外发票和收据的高速版（国际通用）与东南亚版，以及送货单应用: Supported by high-speed custom extraction, overseas invoices and receipts (international high-speed and Southeast Asia versions), and delivery-note apps. Pass true to return where field values appeared in the document. Overrides this call only. Omit to use the app setting. Must be off when cross-page enhancement is active on a high-speed custom app.
返回原文位置（高速自定义、海外高速版及东南亚版、送货单）: Return source positions (high-speed custom, international high-speed or Southeast Asia invoices, delivery notes)
支持高速自定义抽取、海外发票和收据的高速版（国际通用）与东南亚版，以及送货单应用: Supported by high-speed custom extraction, overseas invoices and receipts (international high-speed and Southeast Asia versions), and delivery-note apps. Pass true to calculate and return field confidence. Overrides this call only. Omit to use the app setting. Must be off when cross-page enhancement is active on a high-speed custom app.
返回字段置信度（高速自定义、海外高速版及东南亚版、送货单）: Return field confidence (high-speed custom, international high-speed or Southeast Asia invoices, delivery notes)
按 app_id 抽取时，true（默认）调用同步接口并直接返回结果；false: For app-based extraction, true (default) calls the synchronous endpoint and returns its result. Set false to create an asynchronous task and receive a task_ref for get_task.
按 app_id 抽取时，wait=true 的同步请求时限，默认 60 秒。超: For app-based extraction, the synchronous request timeout in seconds when wait=true. Defaults to 60. A timeout returns an error and the processing outcome may be unknown. Ignored when wait=false.
每次抽取一份文档。用 file_url 提供文件，再选择一种抽取方式：app_i: Extract from one document per call. Provide its download URL in file_url and select either app_id for saved rules or fields for one-off extraction.
需要判断文件的文档类型（如发票、合同），或找出混合文件中每份材料所在的页面时，调:
Classify a file by document type, such as an invoice or contract, or locate each material by page in a mixed file.

1. **Choose a classification app.** Use the `app_id` of a classification app created by the current account whose categories cover the types you need. If this connection offers the classification filter in `list_apps`, search with `engine_type=classify`. If no suitable app exists, call `create_app` with `engine_type=classify`, an app name, and `classify_types`, then use the returned `app_id`.
2. **Submit one file.** Pass `app_id` and one file, for example a download URL in `file_url`. Omit `pages` to classify the whole file. Pass `pages=[2, 4]` to classify only original pages 2 and 4. For multiple files, call once per file and summarize by file. By default the result is returned synchronously. To collect it later, set `wait=false`, then pass the returned `task_ref` to `get_task`.
3. **Interpret the result.** Each entry in `data.segments` gives one material's document type and original page numbers. `data.unclassified_pages` lists the pages processed that matched no category. For a mixed file, report each material and its pages. If the user needs one type for the whole file, classify all pages. Report a single type only if every page matched the same category. If multiple categories matched or any pages were unclassified, report the corresponding pages and mark the whole-file type as needing confirmation.
一份 PDF、JPEG 或 PNG 的 HTTP(S) 下载地址，可使用上传返回: Downloadable HTTP(S) URL for one PDF, JPEG, or PNG. You may use the download_url returned by an upload.
当前账号创建的分类应用 ID，决定本次识别哪些文档类型。使用创建分类应用时保存的: ID of a classification app created by the current account. Its configured categories determine which document types to identify. Use the ID saved when creating the app. If this connection offers the classify filter in list_apps, look it up with engine_type=classify.
只分类指定的原始页码，从 1 开始且不能重复。省略或传 [] 时处理全部页面。例: Classify only these original page numbers, starting at 1 with no duplicates. Omit or pass [] for all pages. For example, selecting [3, 5] retains page numbers 3 and 5 in the result.
本轮需要分类结果时用 true（默认）。多份文件要分别提交、稍后统一查询时用 f: Use true (default) when the result is needed now. To submit files individually and collect the results later, set false. Each file returns its own task_ref for get_task.
传当前账号创建的分类应用 app_id，每次用 file_url 提供一份 PD: Pass the ID of a classification app created by the current account and a file_url for one PDF, JPEG, or PNG per call. Maximum file size is 100 MiB. The original PDF may contain up to 260 pages.
该材料匹配的分类标识，来自分类应用的配置。: Category identifier from the classification app for this material.
该材料匹配的文档类型名称，例如合同或发票。: Document type matched for this material, such as contract or invoice.
该材料在输入文件中的原始页码，从 1 开始。: Original pages for this material in the input file, starting at 1.
每项对应原文件中的一份材料。同一文档类型可能有多份，同一页也可能匹配多个文档类型: One entry per material in the original file. Several materials can have the same type, and a page may match multiple types.
本次参与分类、但未匹配任何文档类型的原始页码。: Original page numbers included in this call that did not match any configured document type.
需要保存可复用的抽取或分类规则，或准备分类文件却没有合适的分类应用时，调用此工具:
Save reusable extraction or classification rules, or create a classification app before classifying a file when no suitable app exists. Set the name with `app_name` and optionally describe its purpose with `description`.

1. **Extraction app.** Use `engine_type=extract` (default) to repeatedly extract the same fields from similar documents. Use `extract_fields` to define field names, types, and extraction prompts, for example the invoice number, issue date, and total including tax. Pass the returned `app_id` and a file to `extract_document`. For a one-off request, specify `fields` directly in `extract_document`.
2. **Classification app.** Use `engine_type=classify` to identify the materials in a file and locate each by its original page numbers. Define the categories in `classify_types`, for example invoices, contracts, and proof of payment. Pass the returned `app_id` and a file to `classify_document`.
extract 创建抽取应用，保存 extract_fields 指定的字段。c: extract creates an extraction app using extract_fields. classify creates a classification app using classify_types. Defaults to extract.
说明此抽取或分类应用的用途。: Describe the purpose of this extraction or classification app.
字段或表格列的稳定标识，在整个配置内不区分大小写且唯一。: Stable key for a field or table column. Must be unique across the configuration, ignoring case.
要输出的业务字段名称，最多 50 个字符，例如“合同金额”。: Business name to display for the field, up to 50 characters, such as Contract amount.
string 表示文本，number 表示数值，date 表示日期，table: Choose string for text, number for a numeric value, date for a date, or table for rows of related values. Supply sub_fields only for table fields.
普通字段或表格列的取值规则，最多 3000 个字符，例如“提取含税总金额”。表格: Instructions for extracting a regular field or table column, up to 3,000 characters, such as Use the tax-inclusive total. For a table, put instructions on its columns.
设置输出格式时必选。preset 使用预置格式，custom 按 instruc: Required when formatting a field. Use preset to select a named format or custom to apply the text provided in instruction.
mode 为 preset 时必选。数值可选 integer（整数）、decim: Required when mode is preset. For numbers, integer and decimal produce plain numbers, and grouped_integer and grouped_decimal use thousands separators. For dates, choose date_iso (year-month-day), date_slash (year/month/day), date_cn (Chinese year, month and day), or datetime (date and time).
mode 为 custom 时必填。例如，填写“金额保留两位小数并附上币种”。: Required when mode is custom. For example, request two decimal places followed by the currency.
仅在 preset 为 decimal 或 grouped_decimal 时填: Used with the decimal or grouped_decimal preset. Use 0 for whole numbers or 2 for two decimal places.
仅用于数值预置格式。half_up 表示四舍五入；truncate 表示截去多余: Used only with numeric presets. half_up rounds half up; truncate discards excess digits.
高速抽取应用的 number 或 date 字段及表格列可设置输出格式。可选预置: High-speed extraction apps support output formatting for numeric and date fields or columns. Select a preset or describe a custom format.
数值或日期的输出格式: Output format for numbers or dates
该表格列的业务名称，最多 50 个字符，例如“商品单价”。: Display name for this table column, up to 50 characters, such as Unit price.
string 表示文本，number 表示数值，date 表示日期。省略时使用: Choose string for text, number for a numeric value or date for a date. Defaults to string.
填写一列的名称、类型和取值规则。例如，商品明细表中的“单价”列可选 number: Define one column by name, type and extraction rule. For example, select number for a unit price column.
选择 table 时至少填写 1 列；按期望的返回顺序逐列填写名称和类型。其他字: For table fields, provide at least one column. List columns in the intended output order with their names and types. Omit this for other field types.
填写一个普通字段或表格字段的定义。表格的列在 sub_fields 中逐项填写。: Define one regular or table field. For a table, specify its columns in sub_fields.
创建抽取应用（engine_type=extract）时必填。定义需复用的字段，: Required when creating an extraction app (engine_type=extract). Define up to 100 scalar fields and 10 tables, with up to 30 columns per table. Field and column keys must be unique across the configuration.
创建分类应用（engine_type=classify）时必填。配置 1 至 1: Required when creating a classification app (engine_type=classify). Define 1 to 10 document types, such as invoices, contracts, and proof of payment.
定义一个要识别的文档类型，提供稳定的类别标识和文档类型名称，可补充判定依据。: Define a document type by its stable key and display name. Optionally describe how to recognize it.
类别的唯一标识。以英文字母开头，后续可用英文字母、数字或下划线，最多 64 个字: Unique category identifier, for example invoice. Start with a letter and use up to 64 ASCII letters, digits, or underscores.
类别名称，例如发票。各项去除首尾空白后须非空，名称不区分大小写唯一。UNCLAS: Category label, for example Invoice. Names must be nonempty after trimming and unique ignoring case. UNCLASSIFIED is reserved.
说明如何识别此类别，或区分相似文档类型。例如，付款凭证应包含付款方、收款方和实付: Explain how to recognize this category or distinguish similar document types. For example, proof of payment typically identifies the payer, payee, and amount paid.
仅适用于抽取应用（engine_type=extract）。用于关联外部业务系统: Only for an extraction app (engine_type=extract). Optional code for linking this app to an external business system, up to 64 characters.
填写一个用于归类应用的标签，例如“采购”。: Enter a label to categorize this app, such as Procurement.
仅适用于抽取应用（engine_type=extract）。按业务为抽取应用设置: Only for an extraction app (engine_type=extract). Add up to five business labels to the extraction app, such as Procurement or Finance.
仅适用于抽取应用（engine_type=extract）。开启后，应用默认返回: Only for an extraction app (engine_type=extract). Enable this to have the app include the source location of each extracted value by default.
仅适用于抽取应用（engine_type=extract）。开启后，应用默认翻译: Only for an extraction app (engine_type=extract). Enable this to have the app translate extracted field values by default.
仅适用于抽取应用（engine_type=extract）。开启后，应用默认返回: Only for an extraction app (engine_type=extract). Enable this to have the app return field confidence by default.
等待应用创建接口回执的最长秒数。: Maximum seconds to wait for the app creation receipt.
填写应用名称。创建抽取应用时传 extract_fields，engine_ty: Provide an app name. For an extraction app, supply extract_fields and use the default engine_type of extract. For a classification app, supply engine_type=classify and classify_types.
按 app_id 修改有权管理的自定义抽取应用。只改名称或说明时直接提交该项。增: Update a custom extraction app you can manage by app_id. To change only its name or description, submit just that change. To edit fields, retrieve the full extract_fields with get_app, edit the affected fields and submit the full list to keep. Returns the app ID and update result.
当前账号有权管理的自定义抽取应用 ID，可用 list_apps 按 engin: ID of a custom extraction app you can manage. Find it with list_apps using engine_type=extract and source=custom.
省略时保留现有说明，传空字符串清除说明。: Omit to keep the current description. Pass an empty string to clear it.
保留现有字段和表格列的 key。高速自定义应用要求 key 全局唯一，长度 1: Retain existing keys for fields and columns. For high-speed custom extraction apps, keys must be globally unique, 1 to 64 letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
高速抽取应用的数值和日期字段或列可设置输出格式。更新字段时保留现有格式，除非需要: High-speed extraction apps support output formatting for numbers and dates, including table columns. Retain the existing format when updating fields unless you intend to change it.
仅在修改字段时提交完整列表，至少 1 项。保留仍需使用的字段、提示词、表格列和格: Only provide this when changing fields. Submit the complete list of at least one field, retaining fields, prompts, columns and formats that should remain in use. High-speed apps allow 100 regular fields and 10 tables, with up to 30 columns per table. Classic apps allow up to 20 top-level fields and 20 columns per table.
仅在更新 extract_fields 时填写参考配置版本。可从 get_app: Specify the reference configuration version only when updating extract_fields. Obtain it from get_app to retain existing field rules.
填写 app_id，并至少提交应用名称、应用说明或完整抽取字段列表中的一项。: Supply the app_id and at least one change: name, description or the complete extraction field list.
按 app_id 删除有权管理的自定义抽取应用及其关联配置和抽取数据，返回删除结: Delete a custom extraction app you can manage, including its associated configuration and extraction data. Call only when the user explicitly asks to delete the entire app. If only the name is known, find it with list_apps using engine_type=extract and source=custom and confirm the target if names collide. To stop one queued document task, use cancel_task.
填写要删除的自定义抽取应用 ID。: Supply the ID of the custom extraction app to delete.
分页列出当前账号可访问的抽取、解析和分类应用，返回名称、`app_id`、业务类:
List accessible extraction, parsing, and classification apps by page. Returns the name, `app_id`, engine type, and source. When looking up a specific app, include the known filters in the lookup itself.

- For a named team extraction app, pass `app_name`, `engine_type=extract`, and `source=custom`. For example, for the team's “Purchase Contracts” app, pass `{"app_name":"Purchase Contracts","engine_type":"extract","source":"custom"}`.
- When only the app name is given, pass `app_name` and the engine type if known. Omit `source` to search both preset and custom apps.
- To extract by document type alone, pass `document_type`, `engine_type=extract`, and `source=preset`.

To browse all apps, pass `{}` and paginate as needed. To read details for a known `app_id`, use `get_app`.
选择 extract（文档抽取）、parse（文档解析）或 classify（文: Choose extract for document extraction, parse for document parsing, or classify for document classification. Omit to list all three types together.
preset 表示平台预置，custom 表示自定义。默认值 all 包含两种来: Use preset for platform presets and custom for custom apps. The default all includes both.
查找指定文档类型的抽取应用，例如身份证、采购订单或发票。填写时 engine_t: Find extraction apps for a document type such as an ID card, purchase order or invoice. Set engine_type to extract or omit it when using this filter.
请求附带可用的输出字段定义。对于抽取应用，返回可用的最新已发布配置的输出字段。: Include available output field definitions. For extraction apps these come from the latest available published configuration.
从第几条记录开始取，按 0 计数。跳过前 20 条时填 20。: Zero-based offset. Enter 20 to skip the first 20 results.
每页返回的条数，默认 20，仍受当前连接的分页上限约束。: Number of items per page. Defaults to 20, subject to the connection's limit.
按需填写筛选条件；省略筛选条件时分页返回可见应用。: Supply filters as needed. Omitting them lists accessible apps in pages.
确认应用详细配置时调用。可通过`app_id`查询抽取应用的详细信息，包含应用名: Use this tool to confirm an app’s configuration. Look up an extraction app by `app_id` to inspect its name, description, field definitions (extraction fields, types and prompts), configuration version, parsing mode and other details.
要查看的抽取应用 ID，可从 list_apps 获取。预置应用提供公开的输出字: ID of the extraction app to inspect, available from list_apps. Presets expose their published output fields when available. Custom extraction apps can return field definitions and prompts the account can read. Standard custom extraction can return a parsing mode. High-speed custom extraction has no parsing mode.
仅用于指定自定义抽取应用的配置版本。省略时读取该应用最新保存的配置。查看预置抽取: Optional configuration version for a custom extraction app. Omit for its latest saved configuration. Omit for presets and other app types.
填写应用 ID。仅在查看指定的自定义抽取配置时填写配置版本。: Provide the app ID. Specify a configuration version only to view a particular custom extraction configuration.
仅在当前账号能读取自定义抽取应用的完整可编辑字段配置时返回。保留原字段 key、: Complete editable fields when readable by this account. Preserves keys, prompts, table columns and formats. Regular fields omit sub_fields. Classic fields without a key omit field_key. The list can be passed back as extract_fields to update_app.
高速自定义应用可为数值和日期配置输出格式。: High-speed custom extraction apps can format numeric and date values.
按票面确认票种后选择。仅确认全电普通发票时可省略。vat_special_inv: Choose the type printed on the invoice. Omit only for a confirmed fully digital ordinary invoice. vat_special_invoice and vat_electronic_special_invoice are special VAT invoices, vat_common_invoice and vat_electronic_invoice are ordinary VAT invoices, and vat_roll_invoice is a roll invoice. vat_electronic_special_invoice_new and vat_electronic_invoice_new are fully digital special and ordinary invoices. motor_vehicle_sale_invoice and used_car_purchase_invoice cover motor vehicle and used car sales. electronic_air_transport and electronic_train_ticket cover electronic air and rail tickets.
票面发票号码，按原样填写，保留前导零。所有票种均必填。: Invoice number exactly as printed, including leading zeros. Required for every supported type.
票面开票日期、填制日期或乘车日期，例如 2026-06-01。所有票种均必填。: Printed issue, preparation or travel date, for example 2026-06-01. Required for every supported type.
发票代码，保留前导零。以下票种必填：增值税专用发票、增值税电子专用发票、增值税普: Invoice code with leading zeros. Required for traditional special VAT, electronic special VAT, ordinary VAT, electronic ordinary VAT, roll, motor vehicle sales and used car sales invoices.
票面价税合计、票价或合计金额，按对应票种填写金额字符串。以下票种必填：电子发票增: Printed price including tax, fare or total as a string. Required for fully digital special and ordinary invoices, used car sales invoices, and electronic air and rail tickets.
票面不含税金额，填写金额字符串。以下票种必填：增值税专用发票、增值税电子专用发票: Printed amount before tax as a string. Required for traditional special VAT, electronic special VAT and motor vehicle sales invoices.
票面校验码，可填写完整号码，服务使用末六位。以下票种必填：增值税普通发票、增值税: Printed verification code. The full code is accepted and its last six digits are used. Required for traditional ordinary VAT, electronic ordinary VAT and roll invoices.
可选的业务实例 ID，省略时由服务生成。: Optional business instance ID. Generated by the service when omitted.
按票面选择票种，填写发票号码、票面日期及相应票种要求的字段。: Choose the invoice type shown on the document and supply its number, date and type-specific fields.
本次查验的执行状态。一致、不一致和未查到均为 succeeded。: Execution status. A match, a mismatch and no matching record are all completed checks with status succeeded.
consistent 为票面信息一致，inconsistent 为不一致，not: consistent means the invoice details match, inconsistent means a mismatch, and not_found means no matching invoice was found. unverifiable means this check could not be completed, unsupported means an unsupported type, and unknown means no conclusion is available.
服务返回的原始验真数据。result.fpVerification 为原始查验结: Original verification data. result.fpVerification is the original conclusion, result.fpIsVoided indicates a void or reversal and result.fpVerificationMsg provides additional details. Report the values actually returned.
失败时返回的错误信息。若受理状态无法确认，避免自动重复提交。: Error details on failure. Avoid automatically repeating a submission when acceptance is uncertain.
本次查验是否有已记录的积分金额。: Whether recorded credit usage is available for this check.
服务端已记录的本次积分金额。: Credits recorded by the service for this check.
本次请求已有的用量明细。: Usage details available for the request.
失败时返回的后续处理建议（如有）。: Suggested next steps on failure, when available.
获取一个文档解析、抽取或分类任务的状态、可用结果和已记录的积分消耗。异步提交后，: Retrieve the status, available results and recorded credits for one parsing, extraction or classification task. After asynchronous submission, pass the original task_ref unchanged. If using a separately recorded task ID, supply both task_id and task_type.
parse 表示解析，extract 表示抽取，classify 表示分类。: parse means parsing, extract means extraction, and classify means classification.
可直接粘贴原调用返回的 task_ref，须含 kind 和 id。使用 tas: Paste the task_ref from the original call, including both kind and id. Omit this object when supplying task_id and task_type separately.
只有原始文档任务 ID 时填写，同时提供 task_type。: Supply the original document task ID together with task_type.
配合 task_id 选择任务类型。parse 表示解析，extract 表示抽: Select the type of task identified by task_id. Use parse, extract or classify.
使用原任务引用，或同时填写任务 ID 和任务类型。两种方式任选其一。: Supply either the original task_ref or both task_id and task_type.
用户要求停止处理时，取消一个仍在排队且尚未被工作节点领取的解析、抽取或分类任务。: When the user asks to stop processing, cancel a parsing, extraction or classification task that is still queued and unclaimed. Pass the original task_ref, or both task_id and task_type. The top-level status is the result of the cancellation attempt. data.status is the task state. If the outcome is uncertain, query the original reference with get_task.
issue 表示使用问题，suggestion 表示改进建议。: Use issue for a product issue or suggestion for an improvement.
概述使用场景、预期结果和实际情况，最多 1000 个字符。: Summarize the use case, expected result, and actual outcome in up to 1,000 characters.
是否允许 ADP 通过当前账号联系用户以跟进反馈，默认允许。: Whether ADP may contact the user through the current account to follow up. Defaults to true.
一个可读取的本地文件路径或 file:/// 地址。: A readable local file path or file:/// URL.
可选。填写用户同意提交的本地文件路径，最多 5 个，每个不超过 50 MiB。: Optional local files the user has approved for this feedback. Include up to 5 files, each no larger than 50 MiB.
用户明确同意提交本次所列附件时设为 true。仅提交文字反馈时可省略。: Set to true only when the user has explicitly approved the attachments listed for this feedback. Omit for text-only feedback.
填写反馈类型和反馈内容，可指定是否允许 ADP 联系跟进。附上本地文件时，须填写: Provide the feedback type and content, and optionally allow ADP to follow up. To attach local files, supply the paths approved by the user and confirm their authorization.
根据票面字段查验一张中国大陆发票，适用于中国区支持的票种。提供票种、发票号码、开: Verify one mainland Chinese invoice from its printed fields, for invoice types supported in the China region. Provide the invoice type, invoice number, issue date, and the invoice code, amount, or check code required for that type. Preserve leading zeros in invoice identifiers. If the user provides only an image or PDF, first use `extract_document` to read these values from the invoice, then submit verification according to its type. Use `verification_status` to report matching details, a mismatch, no record, or an inconclusive result, and describe any returned voided or reversed status.
查询当前授权账号的积分汇总，返回总积分、已用积分、已过期积分和剩余积分。适合回答: Get a credit summary for the currently authorized account, including total, used, expired, and remaining credits. Use this to answer questions such as ‘How many credits are left in my account?’ For usage from a specific document-processing request, read `usage` in the task result. Use `get_task` to continue checking an asynchronous task.
当用户明确要求或同意向 ADP 提交使用问题、功能需求或改进建议时，调用此工具。: Call this tool when the user explicitly asks or agrees to submit an ADP issue, feature request, or improvement suggestion. Provide the feedback type, issue summary, and relevant business context. Attach the specified run logs, extraction configuration, or processing files only with the user's explicit authorization, and include contact details for follow-up when needed. Returns the submission status and any feedback ID provided by the API.
原样返回该项输入的 file_path，成功和失败项均包含。用它区分不同目录中的: The exact file_path supplied for this item, included on both success and failure. Use it to distinguish files with the same name in different directories.
从输入路径取得的本机文件名，file:/// 地址会先解码。无法取得文件名时返回: The local file name derived from the input path after decoding a file:/// URL. Returns an empty string if no file name can be determined. Use file_path and index to identify the source file in that case.
用一句话概括本次文档处理的业务目的，最多 256 个字符。只提供简短业务意图，不: Summarize the business purpose of this document task in one short sentence, up to 256 characters. Provide only a brief intent, without the user’s original words, document contents, download URLs, or personal information.
明确知道当前调用模型时填写模型标识，最多 128 个字符。不确定时省略或填写 u: Supply the current calling model identifier only when known, up to 128 characters. Omit it or use unknown when uncertain. Do not use the client name as the model name.
